events.description: A crowd of civilians confronts a line of riot police in full gear (helmets, shields, batons) in an indoor/outdoor transitional space; tension is high, with officers advancing and civilians gesturing and moving dynamically, consistent with collective violent unrest or imminent clash.

A person is lying on the ground while multiple individuals surround and appear to assault or restrain them; one individual in a purple shirt (visible from f3 onward) is kneeling over the prone person, with others leaning in and engaging physically in a manner consistent with attacking a helpless victim.

A line of police officers in riot gear (helmets, shields, batons) stands in formation facing an unseen crowd, indicating a tense standoff characteristic of collective violent unrest; the scene transitions immediately into visible physical abuse, supporting the context of a riot.

A person in a purple jersey (number 01) is on the ground, surrounded by multiple individuals who appear to be restraining or assaulting them; one person in a plaid shirt is bent over the victim, and others are positioned closely around, suggesting an attack on a helpless individual.

A person in a purple jersey (number 01) is kneeling over another individual lying on the ground, appearing to restrain or assault them; blood is visible on the ground near the victim's head/upper body, and others are gathered around, some reaching toward the scene.

A crowd of people is present on a street at night amid heavy smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canisters), with individuals moving erratically, some covering faces, and visible police presence in the background; the scene shows signs of collective unrest and dispersal under crowd-control measures.

At approximately 67.0–68.5 seconds, a sudden bright flash and rapidly expanding smoke cloud appear near ground level on the street, consistent with a small explosive device (e.g., flashbang or smoke grenade) detonating; no sustained fire or structural damage observed.

Sudden deployment of tear gas or smoke canisters in a public urban area at night, causing dispersal of people; visible dense white smoke clouds rising from street level and spreading across sidewalk and road, with individuals running away.
Aftermath of smoke deployment: shattered glass on sidewalk outside storefronts, indicating property damage during unrest; people still present but movement reduced, suggesting ongoing tension.

Multiple individuals are engaged in close physical confrontation near the white vans; at least two pairs appear to be grappling or striking each other, with rapid movement and postures consistent with mutual combat.

A large, agitated crowd surrounds two white vans parked on the street; people are moving erratically, some running, others converging aggressively; the scene shows sustained collective unrest with chaotic movement and clustering around vehicles, indicative of violent group unrest rather than a peaceful gathering.

A large group of people is gathered on a street at night near the Omni Hotel, with multiple individuals moving rapidly, some appearing to throw objects or engage in aggressive posturing around two white vans; smoke or tear gas is visible in later frames (e.g., f14–f15), and the crowd disperses chaotically in frame f15, consistent with violent unrest or confrontation.

A large group of people is seen running and dispersing on a city street at night, with white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canisters) erupting in the background and spreading across the scene; individuals exhibit panic and evasive movement consistent with crowd unrest or confrontation.
A bright flash and immediate burst of sparks and smoke occur on the street near a building entrance, consistent with a small explosive device detonating (e.g., firework or incendiary device).

Following the explosion, dense smoke spreads across the street, people continue to flee or move erratically, and the scene shows sustained chaotic activity including objects burning on the road and ongoing dispersal—indicative of ongoing violent unrest.

A crowd of people is engaged in violent unrest on a city street at night, with multiple objects (likely incendiary devices or projectiles) being thrown, resulting in bursts of smoke, fire, and sparks; individuals are seen running, scattering, and confronting a line of uniformed officers who deploy smoke/tear gas.
A sudden bright flash and rapid expansion of smoke and sparks on the street near a building entrance, consistent with a small explosive device detonating (e.g., a firework or incendiary canister).
A distinct plume of white smoke erupts upward from near the police line, indicating a projectile (e.g., tear gas canister or flashbang) being deployed or detonating mid-air or on impact.
Two individuals engage in mutual physical combat in front of the Hilton Garden Inn entrance; one in red hoodie and another in dark clothing exchange strikes, including a visible kick and grappling.

A group of people聚集 outside the hotel, moving erratically, some wearing masks/hoods, with objects (e.g., traffic cone) displaced; activity escalates to include the fighting event and appears coordinated/unrestful rather than peaceful gathering.

A large cloud of white smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canisters) rapidly expands across a city street at night, obscuring visibility and causing people to disperse. Individuals are seen running away from the smoke source, and a line of uniformed personnel is visible in the background behind barriers, indicating a confrontation between protesters and law enforcement.

A dense cloud of smoke (likely tear gas or smoke canisters) rapidly spreads across a street at night, obscuring visibility; individuals are seen moving through and reacting to the smoke while a line of uniformed personnel is visible in the background behind barriers, indicating a confrontation between protesters and law enforcement.

The smoke remains thick and pervasive; multiple individuals raise arms (possibly in surrender or protest) while continuing to move within the obscured environment, with law enforcement still present in the background—indicating ongoing unrest and dispersal efforts.
